== English Death Star II comparison ==
The icon is an embedded graphic in the rulebook and slip. The January 2016 visual entry, E slip and current full E face qualify the named Reserve Deck target with Death Star II. The printed face lacks that qualifying icon. ‘one’ remains on the exact full PC face even though machine data omits it. Preserve the original cancellation alternatives and the Virtual families outside the table.
